column1: # assets/ownhealth/grch38_refget.tsv: the GA4GH refget identifier and MD5 of each GRCh38 chromosome.
# og facts writes VRS identifiers on these sequences. Written by scripts/ci/build-refget-table.sh from
# NCBI's RefSeq GRCh38 chromosome FASTA (GCF_000001405.26), upper-cased; refget is sha512t24u (the
# first 24 bytes of SHA-512, base64url), md5 is the M5 tag a .dict gives. Lengths from the assembly report.
